description: Processed numerical results behind the figures of 'A Data-Consistent Approach to Ensemble Filtering'. Checked by scripts/verify_results.py and tests/test_reproduction.py.

lorenz96/calibration_N10.npz.provenance: Figures 1-2. Reduced by src/processing/lorenz96.py (extract_calibration) from the 100 per-seed shards written by src/experiments/baseline.py with EXTENDED_FILTER_ORDER (original cache: results/baseline_extended/seeds).

lorenz96/coverage_ranks_N10.npz.provenance: Figure 2. Reduced (extract_coverage) from the 100 per-seed shards of src/experiments/coverage.py (original cache: results/diagnostics/coverage_v1).

lorenz96/ensemble_size_sweep.npz.provenance: Figure 3. Reduced (extract_ensemble_sweep) from the per-size shards of src/experiments/baseline.py at N in {5,10,15,20,25,30} (original cache: results/sensitivity/ensemble_size/N_*).

lorenz96/hierarchical_bias_variance.npz.provenance: Figure 4. Reduced (extract_hierarchical) from the 585 (truth seed, filter) checkpoints of src/experiments/bias_variance_mc.py --hierarchical (original cache: results/diagnostics/bias_variance_analysis_100x100, 1.2 GB).

lorenz96/n_kappa_bootstrap.npz.provenance: Figure 5. Reduced (extract_n_kappa) from the 1500 cells of src/experiments/n_kappa_bias_variance.py run grid_aae8ed2c (708 MB); bootstrap exactly as in the original analysis notebook.

lorenz96/restart_law_2fbc05cb06f87eaa.np.provenance: Level 2 input (optional). The restart forecast law used by the (N, kappa) run, calibrated by src/experiments/restart_vs_cycled.py (run full_907c3cfc). Recalibrating from scratch reproduces the same identifier.

shallow_water/all_filter_per_window_v3.j.provenance: Figures 6-8, Table 2. Built from shallow_water/runs/ by the scripts ported to src/processing/shallow_water.py (the original files, generated under Python 3.11; rebuilding under Python >= 3.12 changes some means in the last bit).

shallow_water/all_filter_shelf_gamma_E_v.provenance: Figures 6-8, Table 2. Built from shallow_water/runs/ by the scripts ported to src/processing/shallow_water.py (the original files, generated under Python 3.11; rebuilding under Python >= 3.12 changes some means in the last bit).
